question: A circular pizza having a radius of 21 cm. If 75% of it is eaten, what is the area of pizza remaining?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Remaining pizza percentage = 100% − 75% = 25% = 1/4 of total pizza.

Area remaining = (1/4) × π × r²

⇒ Area = (1/4) × (22/7) × 21 × 21

⇒ Area = (1/4) × 1386 = 346.5 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 346.5 cm².**
